claims.head: The Sharks will send Nurse and Kesselring at Quinn
claims.call: The Sharks’ P2 (Nurse and Kesselring) spends at least 56% of its 5-on-5 time against the Sabres’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Sharks keep sending Nurse and Kesselring out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Ryan Warsofsky has been picking a defense pair for the other team’s top line. Tonight the Sabres’ first line is Benson, Östlund and Quinn.

claims.head: Bruisers against finesse
claims.body: The Sharks hit a lot, but the Sabres mostly don’t. San Jose is one of the league’s best for physicality, and Buffalo is near the bottom. Expect most of the big hits to come from the Sharks.

notes.text: Rasmus Dahlin returned in their last game after missing 3 games. Their recent numbers were built mostly without him.
Dennis Gilbert was added to the roster on Oct 14 and has played beside Louis Crevier.
Jason Zucker was added to the roster on Oct 22 and has played beside Josh Norris and Konsta Helenius.
Zach Metsa has started killing penalties: on the ice for 48% of the team’s shorthanded time in 10 games, up from 7% last season.
Josh Norris has started killing penalties: on the ice for 29% of the team’s shorthanded time in 10 games, up from 1% last season.
Igor Chernyshov is out (upper-body injury), reported after he played in their last game. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Alexander Wennberg is out week to week (upper body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-six forward. Collin Graf has taken his spot beside Tyler Toffoli and Mason Marchment.

SJS.head: A tough matchup for the Sharks
SJS.body: Even though San Jose has home-ice advantage, Buffalo has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, and the Sharks will be without Chernyshov. The Sharks’ best way through is a power play that gets going.

BUF.head: The Sabres have a lot going for them
BUF.body: Even though San Jose has home-ice advantage, Buffalo has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, and the Sharks will be without Chernyshov. The Sharks can make it interesting if their power play gets going.

paras: The Sharks have won two in a row, the last a 6-2 rout of Ottawa. The Sabres are 4-4-2.

items.text: Michael Kesselring faces his old team, Buffalo.
The Sabres have been without Alex Lyon all season. Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen is expected to start.
The Sharks are newly without Igor Chernyshov and Alexander Wennberg.
